# OpenDLSS-NR

A Vulkan reimplementation of the DLSS 5 neural rendering network (build 310.8.0), used by the open
neural rendering backend (`gpu/vk/vk_opennr.cpp`). Unmodified upstream copy of the parts the renderer
builds.

- Upstream: https://github.com/maanHimself/OpenDLSS-NR
- Commit: `9d08f4184bbcb9d858e2fb7a7834ec0837a9d2f1` (2026-09-21, "chore: fix network description")
- License: MIT, in `LICENSE`; third-party notes in `NOTICE`. Keep both with any distribution.

What is here and why:

| | |
|---|---|
| `src/` | The host side, C++20: the Vulkan compute context (`vk_context.*`), the model directory loader and weight re-layout (`nr_model.*`), the kernel wrappers (`kernels.*`), the 71-block network graph (`nr_graph.*`), the CPU reference of the arithmetic (`reference.*`, `numeric.h`), and the upstream `dlss5vk` tool (`main.cpp`, `verify.cpp`), which the renderer does not link and the correctness harness does (`scripts/opennr_harness.py`) |
| `shaders/` | The GLSL kernels: the reference route on its own, and the GLSL half of the default route |
| `scripts/ptx/` | The Python generators of the PTX kernels (the fast route, launched through `VK_NV_cuda_kernel_launch`). Standard library only, except `test_fast_divmod.py`, which upstream runs with numpy |
| `LICENSE`, `NOTICE` | Upstream's MIT notice and its third-party note |

Not copied: upstream's `demo/` (a Filament renderer), `ports/` (the WebGPU port), `docs/` (read them
upstream: `network.md`, `numerics.md`, `weights.md`, `execution.md`, `frame.md`), and its Windows build
scripts. Upstream builds with MSVC and PowerShell; here the same sources are compiled with Hookshot's
clang:

- the SPIR-V of `shaders/*.comp` is checked in as `gpu/vk/shaders/opennr_kernels_spv.h`, made and
  checked by `scripts/opennr_kernels.py` (`tests/test_opennr_kernels.py`), with the glslang flags of
  upstream's `scripts/build_shaders.ps1`;
- the PTX is generated by `nx2/build.py` at build time, from the same generator calls as
  `build_shaders.ps1` (the list is in `scripts/opennr_kernels.py`);
- `#include <volk.h>` resolves to `gpu/vk/opennr/volk.h`, a shim over Hookshot's own Vulkan loader
  (or, in the harness, over `libvulkan.so.1`), since upstream links volk.

**No weights are here and nothing here produces them.** The network reads a model directory
(`manifest.json` and its stage files, upstream's `docs/weights.md`) that the player supplies. Nothing in
Hookshot extracts, converts or downloads model data, and nothing is taken from any NVIDIA binary.

Nothing in this folder is edited. A change belongs in `gpu/vk/opennr/` (the adapter) or a new folder
with its own note, per `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
